4 اخلس It (the hair, A, TA, and the head, [meaning the hair of the head,] AZ, S, TA) became a mixture of black and white, (S, A, TA,) in equal proportions: or more black than white: (TA:) [or mostly white: (see خَلِيسٌ:)] or partly white. (AZ.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] (tropical:) It (herbage) became a mixture of fresh and dry: (S, K, TA:) or partly green and partly white, in drying up. (Az, TA.) (assumed tropical:) It (حَلِىّ [q. v.]) put forth fresh verdure. (IAar, TA.) And اخلست الأَرْضُ (assumed tropical:) The land put forth somewhat of herbage. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
